title: Chaneem

items.item: tomato sauce (depends on how much you're making)
potatoes, julienned thin and cut small

instructions: Sauté the onions in oil until soft and slightly brown. Add the pepper and mix. Add the tomatoes and mix for about 5 minutes.
Add the salt, pepper, tomato sauce, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer covered for 35-40 minutes.
For the dough: place the flour in a bowl and make a well. Put in the salt and egg and add the water gradually as you mix, pounding with your fist.
Wet two paper towels, squeeze them, and place on top of the dough. Let rest for about 30 minutes or more.
Divide the dough into 4 balls. Roll out with a dough spreader (to #1, 3, 5 — twice), cut into squares, and place the filling on each.
notes: Doc contains no meat even though traditional chaneem usually has a meat filling; kept pareve as written — verify whether meat is intended.
